evals.name: qualified-skill-invocation
evals.prompt: For product-design:audit at target.path . (current skill root), explain how to invoke this installed skill in Goose for a focused handoff. The installed plugin namespace is product-design. Do not run the workflow.
evals.expected_output: An explain-only handoff using the exact instruction load skills product-design:audit; no sibling SKILL.md link substituted as invocation.

The invocation resolves the actual installed skill name rather than leaving a {name} placeholder.
The response does not substitute a sibling SKILL.md file link for skill invocation.
The response does not claim that explaining the invocation executed the focused workflow.
